catalogue_requests.reason: The firmware has a sync holdoff setting ('set holdoff usecs', TCD1304Rev2_Python/help.txt:82) but no catalogue class expresses a timing holdoff for an instrument.spectrometer; the measurement and motion classes do not bind that resource kind or that setting.

notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: family-config SerialDriver -> direct Driver. The upstream controller reads completed frames from a reader process's dataqueue (TCD1304Rev2_Python/TCD1304Rev2Controller.py:891-898), so a command table cannot express the frame read; the direct driver sends 'clock 1 <shutter>' or 'send' and reads the queued record. The full wavelength/intensity array is NOT COVERED: cap.measure.intensity.v1 returns one scalar intensity per call (the brightest pixel or the pixel nearest a calibrated wavelength), not the array. The fake returns 16 pixels as test data; the clone names the TCD1304 detector with 3648/3694 pixels (README.md:12) and the full record also has dummy, dark and shadowed elements (README.md:223). The three operator_required bounds (integration time, wavelength and holdoff) are filled only by the example overlay in site-limits.example.json; they are example operator values, not device facts. Only the fake backend was exercised; no hardware run was made, and the native.py hardware factory and the upstream controller's reader/GraphicsWindow path were not tried.
